_about: The dashboard's local settings. Copy this file to dashboard/data/config.json (git-ignored) and change only what you need: a key left out takes the value shown here, and keys starting with _ are comments. The service reads the file when it starts, so run `stop` and `start` after a change.
_port: The port of the local web server. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, and the page is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/. `replay` uses 47827 unless told otherwise. Allowed: 1,024 to 65,535.
_live: The game's LIVE folder, holding Game.log and logbackups. null: found from where this repo sits inside the game install (four folders up from the repo root).
_game_process: The program whose presence in the process list means the game is running. Only its name is looked for; the process is never opened.
_poll_seconds: While the game runs, how often the log is read for new lines. Allowed: 0.25 to 10.
_process_check_seconds: How often the process list is read to see whether the game has started or ended. Each look takes about 5 ms. Allowed: 2 to 300.
_state_save_seconds: data/state.json is written at most this often, and only when the state changed. Allowed: 2 to 3600.
_push_min_seconds: The shortest time between two state sends to one page: bursts are merged into their last state (0.5 = at most two a second). Allowed: 0.1 to 10.
_keepalive_seconds: A keepalive event is sent on each event stream when nothing else was for this long, so a closed page is noticed and the page can tell a hung service from a quiet one (it waits two of these plus 3 s). Allowed: 2 to 120.
_retry_ms: How soon a page reconnects after the stream drops, in milliseconds. Allowed: 500 to 60,000.
_max_pages: How many pages may hold the event stream at once. A browser allows six connections to one address, so keep this below six. Allowed: 1 to 5.
_log_max_bytes: data/service.log is rotated to service.log.1 when it reaches this size. Allowed: 50,000 to 50,000,000.
_log_backups: How many rotated copies of service.log are kept. Allowed: 1 to 10.
_sessions_keep: How many session summaries data/sessions/ keeps; the oldest go first. Allowed: 10 to 100,000.
_terminal: The Claude terminal panel (a later stage). With enabled false, the page has no terminal region at all; with true it is laid out with one (in this stage an empty placeholder).
_window: The dashboard's own window, which `scdash.py open` (and the shortcut) starts. browser: the program that shows it; null finds Microsoft Edge, then Google Chrome, where Windows records installed programs (App Paths); otherwise a full path to the program, or a name such as "chrome.exe". Only Chromium browsers take the switches `open` passes. profile: the window's own browser profile folder; null is %LOCALAPPDATA%\scdash\browser, outside the repo and the game folder. `open` reads these each time, so no restart is needed.
